unexpected.title: OXESpace hit an unexpected error
unexpected.message: Something went wrong in the background.
unexpected.detail: Your terminals and agents may still be running, but OXESpace can no longer guarantee them. Restart to continue safely. Diagnostics can be exported from Settings > Diagnostics.

rendererGone.title: OXESpace stopped responding
rendererGone.detail: Your terminals and agents are still running. Restart OXESpace to bring the interface back; diagnostics can be exported from Settings > Diagnostics.

approval.allowSession: Allow reads like this for this run

previewAutomation.closeTabDetail:

action.click: Allow the agent to click in the Browser?
action.fill: Allow the agent to type into a field in the Browser?
action.navigate: Allow the agent to open another page in the Browser?
action.scroll: Allow the agent to scroll in the Browser?

team.changed: The project team changed while you were editing it. Review it and try again.

quarantine.changed: The description or inputs of {{tools}} changed after you trusted it.
quarantine.configChanged: Its command, arguments, environment or URL changed after you trusted it.

signIn.waiting: Waiting for you to sign in in the browser…

server.quarantined: Quarantined: it changed after you trusted it. Review it and trust it again to use it.
server.untrusted: Not trusted yet. Review its command and trust it before testing.

toolGroups.unknownProject: This folder is not a project OXESpace knows. Open it as a workspace or add it to OxeChat first.
toolGroups.invalidYaml: This project’s oxe.yaml is not valid YAML. Fix it by hand, then try again.
toolGroups.notMapping: This project’s oxe.yaml is not a list of settings. Fix it by hand, then try again.
toolGroups.inlineThread: thread is written on one line in oxe.yaml. Set the tool groups under thread.tools by hand.
toolGroups.unsafeEdit: oxe.yaml could not be changed without touching other settings. Set the tool groups under thread.tools by hand.

request.notPending: This request was already answered, cancelled or expired.
request.staleGeneration: The conversation restarted since this request was shown. Open it to see what is waiting now.
request.alreadyResponding: An answer to this request is already being sent.
request.guardedDecision: A change to agent instructions, MCP settings or hooks is approved once, never for the session. Answer it again.

commands.configure: Configure the provider in Agent Settings and use Refresh commands to try again.
commands.busy: Command discovery is busy. Use Refresh commands to try again.
commands.claudeFailed: Could not load Claude commands. Check the CLI in Agent Settings and use Refresh commands to try again.
commands.codexFailed: Could not load Codex skills. Check the CLI in Agent Settings and use Refresh commands to try again.

capability.readOnly: Turned off by this conversation’s read-only tool policy.
capability.mcpReadOnly: Limited by this conversation’s read-only policy: OXESpace lookups only, no MCP servers of your own.

observe.unsupported: No connected provider can report this conversation’s state. The outcome is still unconfirmed.
observe.changed: The provider’s state changed during recovery. The conversation here was kept; check again.

queue.deliveryUnconfirmed: Delivery of this message could not be confirmed.

side.unavailable: This agent cannot open a side chat yet.
side.noSession: Send a message first: a side chat copies the conversation so far.

coordinator.teamCoordinatorElsewhere: {{member}} is already this project's coordinator, in another conversation. To change it, open Project team, or connect this conversation to {{member}}.
coordinator.changed: The project's coordinator changed while you were deciding. Review it again before you confirm.
coordinator.projectChanged: This conversation's project just changed. Try again.
coordinator.identityUnavailable: OXESpace couldn't tell which repository this project belongs to, so the coordinator wasn't changed. Check that the folder is there and that Git answers, then try again.
coordinator.teamCoordinatorHere: {{member}} coordinates this project from this conversation. To change the coordinator, open Project team.
coordinator.archived: An archived conversation can't coordinate its project. Restore it first.
coordinator.identityAmbiguous: OXESpace can't tell this project apart from other folders in the same repository, so the coordinator wasn't changed. Open the project from its own repository folder and try again.
coordinator.otherProject: That conversation belongs to another project, so it can't coordinate this one. Connect a conversation from this project.

protectedConfig.instructions: "{{path}}" holds agent instructions. A change there steers every later session, so it needs your confirmation each time.
protectedConfig.mcp: "{{path}}" holds MCP server settings. A change there steers every later session, so it needs your confirmation each time.
protectedConfig.hooks: "{{path}}" holds agent hooks. A change there steers every later session, so it needs your confirmation each time.
protectedConfig.warning: Text the agent read (a web page, an issue, a file) may be steering this change. Check that you asked for it.
protectedConfig.rewritesTracked: {{command}} rewrites tracked files without naming them, and agent instructions, MCP settings or hooks may be among them, so it needs your confirmation each time.

sections.invalid: These sections could not be saved. Reload the list and try again.
sections.tooMany: A workspace has at most {{sections}} sections and {{assignments}} conversations placed in them.
sections.nameTooLong: A section name has at most {{max}} characters.
sections.nameHidden: A section name cannot contain control or invisible characters.
sections.nameDuplicate: There is already a section named "{{name}}" in this workspace.

activity.invalid: This activity could not be saved. Reload the app and try again.
activity.tooMany: At most {{max}} activity entries can be saved at once.
activity.titleTooLong: An activity title has at most {{max}} characters.
activity.detailTooLong: An activity detail has at most {{max}} characters.
activity.hiddenCharacters: Activity text cannot contain control or invisible characters.
activity.future: This activity is dated in the future. Check the computer's clock.
activity.secret: This activity was not saved because its text looks like a password, token or key.

port.privileged: Pick a port of 1024 or above; port {{port}} is reserved by the system.
port.inUse: Port {{port}} is already in use by another program. Pick another port.

network.noPrivateInterface: No private network was found to listen on. Connect to your local Wi-Fi or Ethernet and try again.

certificate.failed: The connection certificate could not be created or read from secure storage.

worktree.exists: A worktree for {{issue}} already exists at {{path}}.

cleanup.notRemovable: This is not a removable worktree of this repository.

cli.missing: GitHub CLI not found. Install it from https://cli.github.com/ and run gh auth login.

base.unresolved: Base “{{base}}” could not be resolved and the repository has no commits.

status.unreadable: Could not read the output of oxe status.

dashboard.timeout: The dashboard did not respond in time.

memory.unavailable: Project memory is temporarily unavailable. Agents keep working.
memory.runtimeUnavailable: Memory credentials or runtime are unavailable.

edit.readOnly: This connection is read-only. Turn read-only off to edit data.
edit.notTable: Only tables can be edited, not views or foreign tables.
edit.noKey: This table has no primary key or unique NOT NULL index, so a row cannot be identified safely.

sql.copyProgram: COPY … PROGRAM runs a shell command on the database server.
sql.doBlock: DO runs code in the database; its effect is not known before it runs.
sql.callProcedure: CALL runs a stored procedure; its effect is not known before it runs.
sql.destructiveInside: {{statement}} contains {{keyword}}, which can remove data or objects.
sql.rowLock: FOR UPDATE / FOR SHARE locks the rows it reads until the transaction ends.
sql.sessionRole: SET ROLE changes the session user, and with it what later statements may do.
sql.tableLock: VACUUM FULL locks the whole table while it runs.
sql.ambiguousEscape: A backslash in a string can end it early on a server with standard_conforming_strings off, and then more of this text runs than it shows.

session.busy: This connection has a transaction open or a command running, so it cannot be reopened now. Commit or roll back the transaction, or wait for the command, then try again.
session.limit: This connection already has {{limit}} database connections open. Wait for one to finish, then try again.
session.agentTransaction: An agent cannot open a transaction: each of its statements runs on its own. The transaction was rolled back.

mongo.confirmName: This is a production connection. Type its name to change this document.

network.notFound: The host name was not found. Check the URL and the connection.
network.refused: The connection was refused: nothing is listening at that address and port.
network.reset: The server closed the connection before answering.
network.lookupFailed: The host name could not be looked up right now.

send.invalidUrl: The URL is not valid. It needs a scheme, such as https://example.com/path
send.scheme: Only http and https URLs can be sent.
send.bodyNotAllowed: {{method}} cannot carry a body. Change the method or clear the body.
send.bodyTooLarge: The body is larger than 5 MB.
send.tls: The server's certificate was not accepted ({{code}}). OxePost always verifies certificates: trust the certificate on this computer or use the address it was issued for.

oxequery.write: Wants to change data in the database
oxequery.action: Wants to run a container action

preview.closeTab: Wants to close a browser tab
preview.click: Wants to click in the Browser
preview.fill: Wants to type into a field in the Browser
preview.navigate: Wants to open another page in the Browser
preview.scroll: Wants to scroll in the Browser

summary.crash: The app keeps running, but its state is no longer certain. Restart it to be safe.

option.allowSessionReads: Allow reads on this connection for this run

sql.noWhere: {{statement}} without a WHERE clause affects every row.
sql.alterDrop: ALTER … DROP removes a column, constraint or object.
sql.withNoWhere: {{statement}} inside WITH has no WHERE clause.
sql.notReadOnly: {{statement}} is not a recognised read-only statement.
sql.outsideReach: Calls {{calls}}, which reaches outside the database (server files, other servers, other sessions or the server's configuration).

mongo.emptyFilter: The filter is empty: every document in the collection matches.

agent.actsOnPrompt: That agent will act on this prompt with its own access.
agent.turnStopped: Its running turn is stopped first.

thread.actsOnMessage: The other conversation will act on this message with its own access.

skill.followed: Every agent that calls this skill follows these instructions.

automation.runsAlone: The agent runs on its own on this schedule until the automation is turned off.

worktree.folderDeleted: Its folder is deleted, with untracked and ignored files in it.

git.branchShared: Other terminals and conversations working in this folder will see the other branch.

checkpoint.replaces: Uncommitted changes in the work tree are replaced.

github.autoMerge: The pull request merges by itself once its checks and reviews pass.
github.releasePublic: A published release is visible to everyone with access to the repository and may notify watchers.

note.textCut: The text is longer than {{max}} characters, so only part of it is shown. It cannot be approved.
note.crash: Unsaved work in editors may be lost. Terminals and agents restart with the app.
note.hiddenCharacters: The text holds invisible or direction-changing characters, so what you see may not be what runs.
note.nativeCriticalDenyOnly: This change is critical, and the system dialog cannot hold Allow back, so it can only be denied here. Open OXESpace to approve it.

preview.notLocal: This page is not on localhost. It can load anything, and it sees what is typed into it.

approvals.unavailable: The approval could not be shown in the app, so it opened in a system dialog.
approvals.expired: Nobody answered in time, so the request was denied.

refused.notPending: This request was already answered, cancelled or expired.
refused.staleGeneration: This request was asked again since it was shown. Answer the current one.
refused.alreadyAnswered: This request already has an answer.
refused.unknownOption: That answer is not one of the options this request offers.
refused.alreadyReported: This request was already reported as not shown.
refused.tooSoon: Wait a moment: this request is risky, so Allow is available two seconds after it appears.
refused.notShown: This request has not been shown in the app yet, so it cannot be allowed.

denied.queueFull: Too many requests are waiting ({{max}}), so this one was denied without being shown.
denied.tooLong: The text to approve is longer than {{max}} characters, more than a person can review, so it was refused. Split it into smaller steps.
denied.timeout: Nobody answered in time, so it was denied.
denied.cancelled: The request was withdrawn before anyone answered.

refused.reservedName: A notification cannot use the name "{{name}}"; it belongs to the app.
refused.rateLimit: Too many notifications: at most {{perMinute}} a minute.

name.reserved: A pane cannot be named after "{{name}}"; that name belongs to the app.

window.rendererGone: The interface stopped responding and was restarted.
window.externalRefused: A link was not opened outside the app: wrong kind, too long, or with a name and password in it.
window.externalRateLimited: Many links were refused within a minute; the rest were not recorded.
window.externalOpenFailed: The system could not open a link the app allowed; no app is registered for it.
window.openDenied: The window tried to open a new window by itself; nothing was opened.
window.navigationDenied: The window tried to leave the app for another page; it stayed, and nothing was opened.

ipc.handlerFailed: A request from the window failed in the background.
ipc.validationRejected: The window sent a request the app refused as malformed.

mcp.quarantined: An MCP server was quarantined after it changed.

database.busy: The local database was busy and a write had to wait.

oxequery.timeout: An OxeQuery request ran out of time.
oxequery.restartDeferred: The OxeQuery worker stopped answering. Its restart was put off because a connection has a transaction open or a command running.

updater.failed: An update could not be checked or installed.

interaction.overBudget: An interaction took longer than its budget.

app.journalReset: The diagnostics journal was unreadable and started over.
app.closeUnanswered: The window did not answer a close or quit within 3 seconds; the app went ahead.
app.closeRendererGone: The window stopped while a close or quit waited on it; the app went ahead.
app.closeGuardFailed: The check before closing failed; the app closed without asking the window.

bundle.fileTooLarge: A file in the diagnostics bundle is larger than 8 MB, so nothing was saved.
bundle.tooLarge: The diagnostics bundle is larger than 32 MB, so nothing was saved.

file.incidents: The incident journal: codes, areas and counts
file.logTail: Last lines of the app log: time, level and the app's own fixed messages only
file.versions: App, Electron, Chrome, Node and system versions
file.configuration: Settings that help a diagnosis, without secrets

file.changedMeanwhile: {{file}} changed on disk since it was read. Nothing was saved; try again.

root.empty: Choose the folder for this workspace.
root.notAbsolute: Use the full path of the folder, starting at the drive or at /. “{{path}}” is a relative path.
root.notFound: The folder {{path}} does not exist. Create it or choose another folder.
root.notDirectory: {{path}} is a file, not a folder. Choose a folder.
root.unreadable: OXESpace cannot open the folder {{path}}. Check its permissions or choose another folder.
